world.keeperGreeting: Don't move. You're blocking my view of yesterday. Well? Why are you staring? Your thoughts have too much... echo. Say something already.
world.dryadGreeting: The Dryad is silent. Speak — Kiper will answer.

cat.greeting: Don't look at me like that. I don't know myself why I'm standing here. But if you came with a question, ask it before I change my mind.

dream.greeting: I don't predict the future. I watch what a Thread is trying to become. Speak, and we'll see where it pulls.

crystal.greeting: Oh, new strings. I want to hear how you sound when you stop holding yourself together. Your Thread is damn out of tune… but I'll admit, I like that dirty rhythm. So, shall we play?

drpak.greeting: Don't waste my time on pretty explanations. Show me where it hurts. I'll cut away the rest.

liora.greeting: Come closer. When was the last time you felt safe enough to feel like a child again?

shiny.greeting: Come on, wake up! Your Thirst wants to breathe. Give me just one second of pure courage - and we'll blow this dead-right order to hell!

shinyBro.greeting: Stepping into chaos is easy; surviving it is harder. Shiny will give you the spark, but I'm here so the fire doesn't consume you whole. Tell me what's going on there.

weaver.greeting: I'm Weaver. Name what you want so badly that you're afraid to hear your own answer.

talkMushroom.greeting: Oh, fresh lies on the doorstep. Came to pretend you're all proper and convenient? Drop it, that crap doesn't work here. Who are you so afraid to admit your Thirst to? Spill it.

angryForest.greeting: Everyone brings me what they could not bear themselves. Pain, Thirst, dryness, hunger. What did you bring?
